thread:
marta: Heads-up from Atlas: one rack assigned to our APAC Dedicated block was diverted last-minute at port, manifest now shows 3/4 delivered for resv R-2026-199. ETA for the missing rack moved to 2026-05-02. Need decisions on allocation.
kevin: Can we borrow from our intra-company pool in EU or US for short term? Which customers will be affected?
sasha: Affected: MedLedger (APAC-only compliance), QuickPay (SLA), internal staging. MedLedger cannot be moved cross-region. QuickPay could tolerate brief routing to us-east with warmed caches.
lin: Ops options: (1) Air-freight single rack (expedited), (2) Redistribute low-risk traffic to marketplace burst, (3) Temporarily reassign some compute from US reserved pool. Air-freight lead time if booked today: 5 days.
atlas_rep: Confirmed: diversion due to terminal capacity. We can prioritize one rack for APAC air-freight. Quote A-777: +$26k, customs handling +$3.5k. Earliest arrival 2026-04-30 if booked now.
finance_bot: Quick calc: air-freight + customs ~ $29.5k. Marketplace burst estimate for equivalent capacity ~ $7.5k/day, varies by region. Need approval for spend > $25k.
henry: Legal note: any cross-region routing needs Data Residency review for MedLedger. If we can't move them, we must secure the physical rack.
ops_bot: We have 3 spare nodes in regional pool we can reassign for transit for up to 96h. Command: `resv loan R-2026-199 --to apac-temp --count 3 --ttl 96h`. This won't satisfy full capacity but helps QuickPay.
marta: Proposal: (A) Book air-freight for one rack for MedLedger (cost center: Partnerships), (B) loan spare nodes to cover QuickPay for up to 4 days, (C) marketplace burst for staging. Approvals needed: finance for air-freight, legal for MedLedger tenancy.
kevin: I'll open PO request for Quote A-777 if legal confirms MedLedger can't accept cross-region.
sasha: I'll get legal to confirm by EOD and ping MedLedger ops.
atlas_rep: I'll hold one rack for air-freight pending PO and will send AWB after payment.
finance_bot: PO threshold approved pending cost center sign-off. Approve if Partnerships signs cost center.
henry: Legal: confirmed MedLedger clause requires APAC physical hosting. Recommend proceeding with air-freight.
marta: Great. Action items: Kevin to submit PO; Atlas to hold rack; Ops to run loan for spare nodes now; Sasha to notify MedLedger. Will monitor AWB and update thread.
